{{Engineer infobox}}

'''Felicity Farseer''' is a ship Engineer based at '''[[Farseer Inc]]''' in the '''[[Deciat]]''' system. An experienced explorer and propulsion specialist, she is one of the independent entry points into ship [[Engineering]]: no referral from another Engineer is required before a Commander can meet her.<ref name="inara-farseer">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/1/ Felicity Farseer — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-farseer">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Felicity_Farseer Felicity Farseer], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Her highest-grade service is '''Grade 5 Frame Shift Drive engineering'''. She also works on the Detailed Surface Scanner, Sensors, Thrusters, Frame Shift Drive Interdictor, Power Plant, and Shield Booster at lower maximum grades.<ref name="inara-farseer" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Deciat]]
* '''Facility:''' [[Farseer Inc]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' None

Farseer Inc provides the Engineer workshop and Universal Cartographics access used to build reputation with Felicity.

== Access requirements ==

Felicity's whereabouts are available through public data sources. Access requires three direct conditions:<ref name="inara-farseer" />

# Reach the Pilots Federation Exploration rank of '''Scout''' or higher.
# Carry '''1 unit of [[Meta-Alloys]]''' to Farseer Inc.
# Donate the Meta-Alloy to Felicity.

Meta-Alloys are commodities rather than Raw, Manufactured, or Encoded Engineering materials. The unit occupies cargo space and must reach the workshop aboard the visiting ship.

For acquisition advice, route planning, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Felicity Farseer]].

{{Field note|Even as starting Engineer, she is not automatically unlocked. The Scout rank and Meta-Alloy donation still apply.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Felicity increases by:<ref name="inara-farseer" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Farseer Inc.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Felicity supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-farseer" />

== Engineering services ==

The maximum grade is specific to each module family. Felicity's Grade 5 maximum applies only to the Frame Shift Drive.<ref name="inara-farseer" /><ref name="edwiki-farseer" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Felicity can apply compatible Experimental Effects to module families that she engineers even when her maximum blueprint grade for that family is below Grade 5.

=== Detailed Surface Scanner version note ===

Felicity provides Grade 3 Detailed Surface Scanner engineering. In Live, this includes the Operations-era '''Long Range Detailed''' blueprint for compatible Merc modules; the blueprint trades additional mass and power draw for greater probe radius. Long Range Detailed is not available in Legacy.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.0.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 27 May 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-dss-long">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Felicity blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. Pinning does not change the grade that Felicity offers and does not make Experimental Effects available remotely. Blueprint choice depends on the Commander's ships and on blueprints already pinned with other Engineers.

== Direct referral ==

Felicity directly introduces '''[[Juri Ishmaak]]''' after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with her.<ref name="inara-juri">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/13/ Juri Ishmaak — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Juri's own access tasks, workshop, services, and later referrals belong to his article. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
